lastCompletedStory.title: Rebrand package name, README, and CHANGELOG to CAM Runtime

nextStoryContext: package.json 'name' is now 'cam-runtime' (still private/unpublished); bun.lock's workspace name field was hand-edited to match (single-line change, no dependency versions touched -- verified with `bun install --frozen-lockfile` producing only that 1-line diff). README.md: title is now '# CAM Runtime' and the opening paragraph carries the positioning statement verbatim ('CAM Runtime is a local software-delivery runtime for coding agents. It turns issues and goals into verifiable planning, implementation, review, and ship workflows, keeping state, coordinating specialized agents, and recovering interrupted runs.'); the `cam version` help-table line was also updated from 'Print the installed cam-cli version' to 'Print the installed CAM Runtime version' to match the actual index.ts HELP output from US-002 (was already stale before this story). All `github.com/eduardocaminha/cam-cli` repo urls and `cam-cli` directory-name references (git clone/cd instructions) were left untouched -- repo/dir rename is explicitly out of scope. CHANGELOG.md: only the top descriptive line ('All notable changes to CAM Runtime are documented here.') changed; no release-history entries were rewritten. test/release/pr-body.test.ts and test/release/version.test.ts still assert literal 'cam-cli' as directory-derived/local fixture data -- confirmed unchanged and passing (these are fixtures, not the package.json name). test/version.test.ts (version-parity) passes unchanged since it only compares package.json.version to CAM_VERSION.
